newsitem.title: USA: NYC Water Auth. mulling three summer bond sales.
newsitem.headline: NYC Water Auth. mulling three summer bond sales.

text.p: New York City Water Finance Authority might sell tax-exempt debt in three separate bond sales slated for late July or early August, a financial source said on Wednesday.

The Authority, which typically sells new money each autumn and spring, might advance a $300 million to $400 million sale in order to take advantage of a recent drop in interest rates and capture the benefits of using a common plan of finance for all three sales, said the source, who declined to be named.
